tutorial_text.text:
EXECUTION

Parrying is an enhanced block performed by inputting an attack before blocking an opponent attack.



Attacks that match the direction of an upcoming opponent attack will buffer the parry.

The window to perform a parry is roughly twice as long as the early-window to hit a singing note.

Like with blocking, attempting a parry late will fail, and cause the attack input to execute as normal.



BENEFITS

A succesful parry recovers a large chunk of stamina and health,

and grants an all-guard benefit that automatically defends against most attacks, including unblockables.

Unblockable attacks can only be defended against by parrying, or with an active all-guard.



GUARD VOID

Executing an attack cancels any active all-guards.

Buffering a parry does not count as an attack, but if an attack does not match an opponent attack, an attack will be performed as normal.



ENEMY SPECIALS

Enemy special attacks typically cannot be parried, thus attempted parries will resolve as attacks.

Attacks also void active dodges, thus attempting to parry a special may leave you vulnerable.
